requirements.text: Workspace admins can invite teammates by entering one or more email addresses.
details: When an admin submits up to 20 valid addresses, then each address receives an invite email within 2 minutes.
If an address is malformed, then the form shows an inline error and no invite is sent for it.
If the address already belongs to a member, then the admin sees "already a member".

requirements.text: Workspace admins can set the role (Admin or Member) for each invite.
details: Given a role is selected, when the invite is accepted, then the new member has that role.

requirements.text: Workspace admins can resend a pending invite.
details: Resending generates a new link and invalidates the previous one.

requirements.text: Invitees can accept an invite from the email link and join the workspace.
details: When an invitee with an existing account opens a valid link, then they join the workspace after one confirmation click.
When an invitee without an account opens a valid link, then they are taken to sign-up with the email prefilled.

requirements.text: Invite links must expire after 7 days.
details: If an invitee opens an expired link, then they see an expiry message and a button to request a new invite.

requirements.text: The invite flow should be fast and easy for invitees.
Workspace admins can view all pending invites with sender, role and sent date.
Workspace admins can revoke a pending invite.
details: When an admin revokes an invite, then its link stops working immediately.

requirements.text: The system must record an audit log entry for every invite sent, accepted, resent or revoked.
details: Each entry includes actor, target email, action and timestamp in UTC.

requirements.text: Invite emails must be sent through the existing transactional email provider.
The system must rate-limit invites to 200 per workspace per day.
Invite tokens must be single-use and at least 128 bits of entropy.

outOfScope.text: Inviting users via SCIM or directory sync.

risks.description: Invite emails may land in spam folders, lowering acceptance rate.
Rate limits that are too strict could block legitimate onboarding for large teams.
Unresolved question: Should Members (not only Admins) be allowed to send invites?
risks.mitigation: Resolve with the PRD owner before the related stories enter a sprint.
